scope: P3 account content preferences, server-specific DM permissions and personalized friend-request introductions
implemented: Server-validated account preferences for sexual and disturbing media policy by friend DM, other DM and server-channel scope.
Server-validated spam mode with all, nonfriends and off values.
Global server-member DM default plus bounded per-server overrides, editable from the real joined-server list with search and override count.
New non-friend conversations enforce the recipient's common-server DM policy on the server; existing conversations and friends are not retroactively removed.
Shared-server friend-request eligibility honors the same recipient server-DM overrides.

Personalized friend-request introduction preference removes the introduction field and prevents delivery when disabled. Enabled introductions continue through the normal encrypted DM send path and remain in conversation history.

verification.command: vitest run preferencesStore, textToSpeech and useUserProfile

not_claimed: Media and spam classification and the spam inbox are not implemented by this evidence.
Two-client browser acceptance remains pending because the local acceptance frontend is currently bound to an unavailable API port.
